sbh3.1:4.2: Printed *balam*; read *calam* 'unsteady' (Xuanzang 麁動, T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.1:5.3: Printed text omits the rest of this definition and the whole definition of *upasthāpayati*; not supplied (cf. 12.5; Xuanzang 復還攝錄安置內境, T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.1:6.3: Printed *gatvarasaṁspraṣṭavya-*; read *rūpaśabdagandharasaspraṣṭavya-* 'forms, sounds, smells, tastes, tangibles' (Xuanzang 色聲香味觸, T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.1:11.2: Printed text omits *saṁprajanyabalena*; supplied from Xuanzang 正知力 (T1579 juan 30; cf. 12.7).
sbh3.1:12.10: Printed text omits *vyupaśamayati*; supplied from Xuanzang 最極寂靜 (T1579 juan 30).
